title: ALMA suggests outflows in z ∼ 5.5 galaxies
question: Do the [CII] 158um lines of z~5.5 star-forming galaxies show broad wings indicating starburst-driven outflows?

what.value: [CII] ALMA spectra and sample of galaxies (SFR, stellar masses)

evidence.quote: spectra of the \[CII\]158$\mu$m line have been obtained with ALMA at an angular resolution of[^1] $\sim$0.6” by (cite: Capak15)

external_data.citation: Capak P. L. et al., 2015, Nature, 522, 455

what.value: Zoom-in RAMSES simulation of the galaxy Dahlia

evidence.quote: These simulations are fully described in (cite: pallottini:2017)

recipe.goal: Fit Gaussians and compute normalized residuals
recipe.method: Fit each [CII] line with a Gaussian (FWHM, peak, v0); noise from std at |v|>700 km/s; R=(Fobs-Fmod)/sigma_n

recipe.goal: Stack residuals and test against Gaussian noise
recipe.method: Average residuals of 9 galaxies; compare CDF with erf via KS and Anderson-Darling tests

recipe.goal: Compare outflow, satellite and rotating-disk scenarios
recipe.method: 500 Monte Carlo synthetic spectra per scenario in sub-samples of 9, same fit/stack procedure, KS test against observed CDF
assumptions: One satellite per beam; halo occupation model

recipe.goal: Estimate outflow rate and loading factor

evidence.quote: We find a flux excess of $\sim 0.5$ mJy extended over $\sim 1000$ km s$^{-1}$.
we infer an outflow rate of $\rm \dot{M}=54\pm23~ M_{\odot}~yr^{-1}$
We find that the distance from the observed CDF is minimized by the *Outflow* scenario ($D_{\rm KS}=0.05$).

not_stated_but_needed: Spectral channel width and spectral extraction aperture per galaxy
Exact conversion from [CII] luminosity to outflow mass
Random seeds and ranges used for the Monte Carlo realization selection
missing_for_reproduction: CASA version and exact reduction scripts
score_reason: Public data and a clear statistical method, but several processing and fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival data, a simple residual-stacking recipe, and numeric results.
